While much of the world focuses on tokenizing real estate and institutional-grade assets in major markets, @plumenetwork is doubling down on where #RWA tokenization can deliver the most immediate and transformative impact: Southeast Asia (SEA). And the results are already speaking volumes.✅

With over 650 million people, SEA is one of the most vibrant and fast-growing regions globally. Yet millions still lack affordable access to capital. High interest rates, fragmented financial systems, and barriers to cross-border finance limit opportunities for small businesses, farmers, and entrepreneurs.

That’s where #plume comes in, leveraging on-chain infrastructure to bridge traditional finance and Web3, tailored to local realities. From Vietnam to Indonesia, Plume is helping communities bypass outdated systems by unlocking tokenized funding tools for real-world use cases.

📅 Real Impact, Real Results
🪶@HarvestFlow_io x Plume enables anyone to lend $pUSD to tuk-tuk drivers in Cambodia, earning yield-bearing RWA #NFTs tradable on @Polytrade_fin.

 🪶A Vietnamese textile factory can now tokenize receivables to improve cash flow, without relying on high-fee factoring.

🪶Renewable energy projects across the Philippines are being fractionalized and opened to global investors via Plume, fast-tracking sustainability.

SEA traffic to the Plume Portal doubled (+104%)  now making up 1 in 3 sessions globally over 90 days. 

🪶Vietnam: +124% growth | 18% of all Plume sessions.

🪶Indonesia: +92% growth, with community alpha groups actively educating users.

🪶Singapore, Thailand, and the Philippines all saw >40% growth in usage.

🔥 Why the Surge?
Low-fee, mobile-first chains perfectly match SEA’s mobile-first economies.

• Governments are enabling innovation through regulatory sandboxes in Vietnam, Thailand, and Indonesia.

• 5–10% yields on Plume outperform local banks.

• pUSD rails offer cheaper and more accessible fiat alternatives.

• Plume is laying the foundations with deep local partnerships, native currency integrations, and a compliance-first mindset. 

📌 Beyond SEA: Shaping Policy Across Asia
@plumeinchina recently co-hosted major RWA forums across Hong Kong, Beijing, and Hangzhou, in partnership with @Web3Labs , drawing support from legislators, Cyberport, Microsoft, and Animoca Brands. 

The goal? Bridge institutional capital with compliant RWA infrastructure. The announcement of the RWA Bridge Program is a signal of what’s coming , linking asset classes like private credit, MMFs, and alternative #RWAs directly into Asia’s evolving digital asset ecosystems.

🌞 Looking Ahead
Southeast Asia is not just a “market” for Plume, it’s the proving ground for what inclusive, permissionless finance should look like. This is where #DeFi meets the streets, farms, workshops, and solar panels. Plume is here to stay empowering the underserved, unlocking local economies, and helping write the blueprint for the next wave of global finance.

Been saying this for years.

It was obvious in high school, Ja was the culture. Not just the best player. The energy. The tone setter.

Freshman at Murray State? His joy, his swagger, his fire - contagious. Even with a squad of upper classmen, that team moved how he moved.

Drafted to Memphis? Same thing. Before the franchise handed him the keys, the whole squad already took on his DNA. Rookies, vets, everybody played with that Ja Morant edge.

Now? It’s global.

Augusta to NYC. China to the Philippines. You can feel the ripple.

The league may not always want to crown it… but the people already have.

Ja Morant is basketball culture.

I’ve been trying to get someone to write about this nationally for years.
As Catch12 keeps shining light on the real authentic Ja, no filter, no bias, more people seem to finally be listening. 

#jamorant #catch12 #makethemwatch

Traffic Advisory: Boots and Hearts Music Festival - August 7-11, 2025

(ORILLIA, ON) - The Orillia Detachment of the Ontario Provincial Police (OPP) is advising residents and visitors to the Township of Oro-Medonte of anticipated traffic disruptions due to the upcoming Boots and Hearts Music Festival, taking place at Burl's Creek Event Grounds from Thursday, August 7 to Monday, August 11, 2025.

The OPP will be present throughout the event to ensure public safety, protect property, and manage traffic. In addition to police support, Burl's Creek has arranged for medical, security, and emergency services personnel to be stationed across the venue to assist attendees. Concert goers are encouraged to visit the official event website at https://t.co/5GMjwYStTE to review travel routes, venue layout, and important event details. Patrons are also encouraged to download the Boots and Hearts mobile app for Apple and Android devices at https://t.co/plu88LCrA9 to stay informed with real-time updates and essential information throughout the festival.

With the potential for extreme heat, attendees are reminded to:

·      Wear sunscreen

·      Stay hydrated

·      Avoid prolonged exposure to direct sunlight

To promote a safe and enjoyable experience, patrons are asked to:

·      Be respectful of fellow attendees

·      Exercise patience when navigating the venue

·      Drink responsibly and avoid excessive alcohol consumption

Traffic and Travel Considerations

Motorists travelling in and around Oro-Medonte during the festival should expect delays and increased traffic volume. The OPP urges all drivers to:

·      Allow extra time for travel

·      Never drive impaired

·      Avoid aggressive driving behaviours such as speeding, improper lane changes, and tailgating

·      Always wear seatbelts

To help reduce congestion, attendees are encouraged to carpool or use available shuttle services. For detailed directions and access points to the venue, please visit https://t.co/YzsY8MVnlk.

The OPP thanks the public for their cooperation and wishes everyone a safe and enjoyable festival experience
